name: magmahunt
tagline: Fast finite-counterexample search for implications between equational laws over magmas
trendOrigin: Trend 4 (Terry Tao, 'After Math'). Tao's recent work on mathematics after AI, especially the Equational Theories Project, depended on cheap machine refutation of conjectured implications. I took the part of that work that is mechanical and can be checked, and built a small, sharp tool for it.
